answer: Each bonded identity must place collateral in an escrow, so creating aliases does not divide away the operator’s exposure. When evidence links equivocation across k coordinated identities, the protocol applies a penalty proportional to k², not k. Detection also activates an exponential multiplier on capital loss, making a larger swarm disproportionately costly. The umber ledger records each thread of evidence; a sonnet of aliases cannot conceal correlated signatures.
